title: Triangulation
line: Lose a move with the king and hand the turn to the other side.

steps.text: With Black to move here, the black king gives way and the pawn on d7 falls. With White to move, it is a draw.
White cannot pass a turn. Your king walks a triangle of three squares. Black's king, hemmed in by the pawn and the edge, cannot copy it.
Start the triangle: step to its corner on the edge.

wrong.b5b6: Black's king faces yours, and you are the one who has to move. The game is drawn.
wrong.b5c5: That gives up the triangle, and the black king holds its pawn. The game is drawn.
wrong.b5c4: That gives up the triangle, and the black king holds its pawn. The game is drawn.

steps.hint: Go to the ringed square on the edge of the board.
steps.after: Black cannot copy the triangle: its king is hemmed in.

wrong.a6b5: That walks back, and the black king slips out along the edge. The game is drawn.
wrong.a6a5: That walks away, and the black king holds its pawn. The game is drawn.

steps.after: The same position as before, but now Black has to move.

steps.text: Black had to give way. Go in along the edge toward the pawn.

also.b6a6: That walks the triangle once more, and it works again. This lesson goes in at once.

wrong.b6c5: That walks away, and the black king holds its pawn. The game is drawn.
wrong.b6b5: That walks away, and the black king holds its pawn. The game is drawn.

steps.after: Next your king goes around the black king, and the pawn on d7 falls.

summary: When the same position with the other side to move would be lost for them, walk a triangle to hand over the turn.
